purpose: Counterfactual pre-2008 crash research only; never production data or an execution record.

proxy_map.SPX: Fama/French market excess return plus RF
proxy_map.BOND: RF before DGS10; then duration-7 total-return approximation from DGS10
proxy_map.GOLD: flat before the Fama/French Gold industry exists in 1963; then Gold mining equity return, a high-beta proxy rather than bullion
proxy_map.OIL: Fama/French 49-industry Oil equity return; regime input only
proxy_map.USD: flat before 1973; then FRED major-currency dollar index
proxy_map.VIX: 20-day realized market volatility before Cboe VIX history
proxy_map.VIX3M: set equal to VIX; term structure deliberately neutral
proxy_map.VIX_HEDGE: flat; no hypothetical pre-inception hedge payoff

known_limitations: No historical open prices; crash replay assigns daily proxy returns after the synthetic open.
1929 first-leg crash cannot be tested because the 1008-session HMM warm-up is incomplete.
Pre-inception assets are economic proxies, not tradable ETF returns.
The GOLD sleeve uses gold-mining equities after 1963 and can behave very differently from bullion.
